research_signals.observation: Observed 2 content items in the last 30 days (0.47 per week in the observed window); days since latest content: 6.
Across 13 items with engagement data, average likes were 2174.46, median likes 102.0, average comments 25.0, and follower-normalized engagement rate was 6.641%.

CTA detected in 9 analyzed content items (69.23%). Observed intent labels: {'encourage product consideration': 1, 'encourage sushi purchase': 1, 'visit or order the lunch offer': 1, 'redeem employee discount': 2, 'share with an a-name contact': 1, 'treat or invite the sender': 1, 'attend the event': 1, 'invite a dining companion': 1}.

Promotional intent detected in 10 analyzed content items (76.92%). Observed promotion intent labels: {'product promotion': 1, 'menu item promotion': 2, 'sushi menu promotion': 1, 'limited-time lunch bundles': 1, 'partner employee discount': 1, 'employee discount partnership': 1, 'sushi product promotion': 1, 'festival appearance announcement': 1, 'restaurant visit promotion': 1}.

raw_data.caption: زوجتك ما تبا منك باقة ورد! تبا منك سوشي من اشي سوشي🍣
raw_data.alt_text: Video by اشي سوشي - Ashi Sushi on September 09, 2026.

analysis.content_type: short-form video (cover image analyzed; no transcript provided)
content_themes: sushi as an alternative gift to flowers

promotion.description: The post promotes Ashi Sushi's sushi as a playful, desirable gift alternative to a bouquet of flowers.

analysis.visual_summary: The cover shows a masked Ashi Sushi staff member in a kitchen holding a plated sushi roll toward the camera and a sign reading "تبا منك سوشي." The ASHI / أشي logo appears at the top right and on the staff member's headwear.
analysis.caption_summary: In Gulf Arabic, the caption says: "Your wife doesn’t want a bouquet of flowers from you! She wants sushi from Ashi Sushi," framing sushi as a humorous romantic gift.

evidence.text: "زوجتك ما تبا منك باقة ورد! تبا منك سوشي من اشي سوشي🍣" presents Ashi Sushi as a preferred alternative to giving flowers.
A staff member presents a plate of sushi in a restaurant kitchen; the ASHI / أشي logo is visible, along with the sign "تبا منك سوشي."
The item is supplied as a Video/clips post with 4,933 views, 287 likes, and 7 comments; no Reel transcript or duration is available.

evidence.text: The cover prominently displays assorted sushi rolls presented in a wooden boat, with chopsticks lifting one piece.
The Ashi / اشي logo is visible at the lower left of the cover.
The on-screen text frames sushi as an invitation, while the caption explicitly says the invitation is for 'our sushi boat.'
